summary: Added --query-file (teach, teach-playbook, playbook amend) and --add-note-file (playbook amend) flags, read via os.ReadFile mirroring the existing --playbook-file/--notes-file pattern, and rewrote SKILL.md's Step 4-6 recipes to write free-form user text to a scratch file and pass its path instead of constructing any shell heredoc.
reason: Three consecutive rounds of PR review (Greptile) rejected doc-only fixes to SKILL.md's heredoc-based safe-quoting recipes (literal EOF delimiter, then a randomized-example delimiter, then a non-resolvable placeholder) as structurally unfixable: any heredoc pattern documented in a file is, to a static security reviewer, an executable-shell-code example containing a fixed literal a user's text could match on a standalone line to escape it. Eliminating the heredoc entirely -- by giving the CLI a file-based input path so the shell command never contains user-controlled text at all -- removes the vulnerability class instead of re-wording its description.
validated_outcome: go build ./... and go test -count=1 ./... pass, including new file-flag happy-path, mutual-exclusivity, and missing-file test scenarios; no heredoc construct (`<<'...'`/`cat <<`) remains anywhere in SKILL.md.
